section_intro:
This layer is `ProjectModel.roles` and the standing debts that travel with it: section 7 states the three role sentences as one statement, and section 8 states, as facts, what is not established.

SECTION 7 IS A SUMMARY, AND IS HELD TO A SUMMARY'S DISCIPLINE. Every clause of it restates a block of sections 1 to 5, and no clause of it may be stronger than the block it restates: where the earlier block attaches a caveat — a registered quantifier wider than the computation behind it, a venue whose value set forecloses the shape being looked for, a ledger ITEM this document has already corrected, a gate whose check cannot fail — that caveat is carried here, in the sentence that needs it and in the scope cell, or the claim is not made. Clauses found stronger than their sources in this pass are corrected in the blocks below rather than annotated here.

THIS HEADER STATES NO NUMBER, NO ROW AND NO COUNT OF ITS OWN. `replicate/check_proof.py` parses `### P-` blocks and nothing else, so a substantive claim made in a header would be a claim outside the five-cell contract and outside the gate. Everything of substance in this layer is in a block below, with its rows, its statuses and its carrier marks.

SECTION 8 IS NOT THE LIMITS STATEMENT, but less of `T-17` is outstanding than this section previously claimed. The ledger's `BLOCKED` rows are all named below, in P-ROLES-11, with the note that their texts predate `T-41`. Section 8 also now carries the debt this document's own writing created, stated last, in P-ROLES-13, so that a reader who stops at the end of the section still reaches it. What `T-17` still owes is the other half of its DONE_WHEN, the plain sentence about what this program is and is not, and that belongs in this document's next pass.

claims.headline: the roles statement preserves every ingredient's evidence tier and carrier mark
claims.prose: The roles layer states the program's current account without flattening its evidence: EM supplies the complex and the record; Gamma supplies space, writer, protection, and channel; physical alpha has the exact construction-scoped active-EM ALLOW interval and, for same-sector ACTVIS records with independently established governing-domain ancestry under SAI1--SAI8, the governing domain's empirically anchored alpha and RG trajectory are REQUIRED as constitutive identity, while SELECT remains separate/open; and the Gravity Formation Theory implication remains conditional on adopted RGRL and WTC-H1--H5. The alpha interval is construction-scoped, and its 0.50 read contrast is separately typed from the GFT Gate. The sealed T-15 per-clause table remains historical evidence for the earlier role assembly: its seventeen then-current load-bearing citations carried TWO-CARRIER marks at landing. That finding is not generalized to the later A-AL2 and GFT-1 additions, whose own theorem/scope content is NOT-CARRIER-SHAPED and whose declared premises and ceilings travel with them. C-72 also moved to PARTIAL after T-15, so the old live-non-PARTIAL condition is historical rather than current; only its surviving accumulate-versus-screen discriminator and closed-form floor are carried here, never the withdrawn ratio prediction. Exactly one cited row holds status PROVED, C-71. Every other ingredient retains its registered status, carrier verdict, and caveat. The model methods and focused gates cover bounded parts of this assembly, but no validator turns the combined summary itself, alpha selection, empirical RGRL confirmation, gravity, or numerical G into a proved result.

claims.headline: em supplies the complex and the record
claims.prose: In the corner the record space is the homology of EM's own chain complex: the Z2 gauge degeneracy equals 2^dim H_1 on pinch-point complexes, a pure graph, and two tori wedged at a point (8 = 8, 4 = 4, 16 = 16), while the surface law 2 - chi fails on 7 of 11 carriers — G-10's ITEM still writes '6 of 11', the slip P-CORNER-8 records and this block does not reprint, and the sealed LANE_G10_NONMANIFOLD/g10_nonmanifold.txt carries seven SURFACE = FAILS rows, so an erratum to the row is owed (G-10). In the world the accumulated quantity that formation creates is electromagnetic on both of the surfaces the record rows name, and on neither was a device measured. WHAT THE OCCUPANCY SURFACE OWNS IS THE SIGN: the write injects one carrier sign on every programmed cell, so a page's net trapped charge carries the program carrier's sign — negative on an electron-injection part — for every data pattern whose page-level |sum Q| clears the surface's own declared unwritten tolerance, while a page below that tolerance is read as unwritten and carries no sign claim; and the unwritten page is null at -38 e inside that tolerance, +-5 e/cell (5000 e), from the same instrument in the same run (C-71). WHAT THIS BLOCK PREVIOUSLY CLAIMED HERE IS WITHDRAWN. 'Ratio exactly 1 for every data pattern' was an algebraic identity of scoring an erased cell at exactly zero charge, the check that gated it is gone from model/validate_geometry.py because it could not fail (D-8), and under the model's own +-5 e over-erase residual the ratio is pattern-dependent and reaches 1 on no page; C-72 now stands PARTIAL, blocked by T-50, and the ratio law is not restated as a prediction here or anywhere in this layer. WHAT SURVIVES OF C-72 IS A BOUND AND A SEPARATION. Six erratum-era checks first gated their raw-ratio form; T-50 has since replaced that topology with eight hardened S1–S6/B2/A2 gates carrying the sign and contrast through self-referenced reads. Through one instrument at one tolerance, the closed-form floor (Q_p f - D(1-f))/(Q_p f + D(1-f)) bounds every treated occupancy page from below — 0.904762 at f = 0.5 — and the worst treated page sits at 0.965292 at N = 1000, against the best of 200 treated orientation random pages at 0.091817: an 11x separation that widens to 112x at N = 1e5, because the occupancy floor contains no N and the orientation ceiling falls like 1/sqrt(N). In that historical erratum run the zero carried configuration controls under the identical treatment: the unwritten page screens at 0.013909, BELOW the orientation ceiling, so screening is a property of the written state and not of the encoding label; the all-programmed page sits at the f -> 1 endpoint of the same floor at 1.000000; and the DC-saturated orientation page accumulates at 1.000000, so what screens the orientation random page is the data and not the tolerance the treatment adds (C-72). The orientation surface behaves as its encoding predicts on the same instrument: random data screens to 0.0027 at N = 1e5 — but the AC-erased control screens to 0.002620 on that same instrument, so the screening does not distinguish a demagnetised medium from a real data track, and one-signedness here belongs to DC-saturated writing alone, the encoding supplying no accumulating quantity for a medium that is carrying data (C-72, sealed seed 7). ProjectModel.formation_occupancy and ProjectModel.formation_orientation run both encodings through the single configuration instrument of the FORMATION layer.

claims.headline: gamma supplies space, writer, protection and channel
claims.prose: Capacity and protection are independent: a bouquet of k triangles has dim H_1 = 2, 3, 4 at true code distance d = 1, while the L x L torus has dim H_1 = 2 at d = 2, 3, 4 (G-11, whose ledger status is MEASURED and not FORMAL, so this is a sweep and not a theorem). On a D(G) carrier clause (iv) requires every eigenspace to be even-dimensional, and that direction is general: the parity broke on every odd group order tested and was unobstructed on every power-of-two one, the abelian Z_3 failing where the non-abelian D_4 passes, which makes it a statement about group order and not about commutativity. The verification is seven carriers over five groups, and records are actually constructed only on D(Z_2) and D(D_4), so C-41's registered quantifier over ALL D(G) is wider than the computation and that scope travels with the claim (C-41, O-35). The writer's weight is the earned geometry, and this clause carries both tiers: d_W satisfies all four metric axioms over all pairs and all triples on eight configuration venues and on two record venues — the barrier-work metric on a weighted hypercube Q_6 whose six weights are the census's published activation energies, and the hidden NAND-like interaction grid of LANE_T42_B_WORLDDIST — with a failing control on the same instrument, and neither record venue is an instrument reading of a device (C-78). The one pure-Gamma separation law is w_min = d on exhaustive coset scans of the (3,7) venue (C-80). Pure-Gamma two-region relations are identically zero beyond contact — I_IR = I_MI = 0 at every positive earned separation, every s, L to 12, exact over F_2 — against the single-contact seam law I_IR = 2(s-2) and, on width-2 rings at L = 8, a distance-independent winding constant I_IR = I_MI = IDENT = w = 2, as the positive controls in the same instrument; so no pure-Gamma falloff was EARNED on these venues and the falloff belongs to the declared coupling. That is a corner-tier null on a stabiliser carrier whose value set of -1, 0 and +1 forecloses a continuous profile in principle, and it reads two ways — as the different-shape hypothesis, or as no such structure being present — with neither reading a baseline (C-80). Protection in the world is energetic and not kinematic: twelve of the thirteen census records are erased only by a local operation at a finite energy price, the six with a measured barrier running E_b/kT from about 40 at the latch to 780 at SD magnetite, while the thirteenth, the CMB photon in free flight, carries no barrier at all and is flipped by the same local waveplate at about zero energy — so C-66's registered 'all thirteen ... 50 to 780' is wider than its own census table on the count and on the low end, and is owed an erratum; the mechanism is a different one from degeneracy and homology protection (C-66), whose corner form is the E_b -> infinity limit verified as a limit at 96/96, 1536/1536 and 24/24 slow modes against the independently computed commutant dimension (C-75). The channel is the coupling making the environment's evolution conditional on the record, so the divergence of the two conditional environment states is the copy and the record's value stays constant (F-20); clause (ii) is a condition on the environment (C-17); and a Gamma-priced coupling reaches three located classes with no fourth appearing in the swept family — C-87's registered EXACTLY THREE is wider than the sealed lane and its judge, and the weaker reading is what this clause carries (C-87); ProjectModel.reachable_class and checks_classes.py now carry that weaker reading through the integrated URM.

The writer clause carries BOTH tiers, as A-PR and the sealed T-15 table both mark it: C-78's eight configuration venues are corner-tier and its two record venues are world-tier, and the world venues are modelled — a hypercube whose weights are published activation energies and a hidden interaction grid — so neither is an instrument reading. claims.headline: alpha sets the cost, and alpha names a generic coupling strength
claims.prose: Alpha is a sum of local terms that splits the record space at order n*, the fewest available local terms whose product reaches the code space — and n* equals d only when the perturbation class is unrestricted (C-8): symmetry degeneracy splits at first order with slope = d on five codes, measured and not proved (O-2), and the formation threshold equals the destruction threshold at d, measured at d = 2 (F-11, cited here for its carrier mark and not as warrant — the register's D-10 classes its six-code verification as an instrument check with no branch on which it could have come out otherwise, and P-FORM-3 declines it on that ground); O-10's row still reads THE THRESHOLD=d SCALING IS UNTESTED, and only its EVIDENCE cell records the scaling as since proved for every stabiliser code and every coupling. In the world the cost appears as the barrier: each record's drop time t*_i = f0^-1 exp((B_i - dE_i)/kT)/(1 + exp(-dE_i/kT)) is set by its own barrier and bias with no fitted width anywhere in it, carrying one declared and underived assumption — a shared Kramers prefactor f0 for both wells — and the lane instrument agrees with the formula to 6.0e-15 relative on the two-well grid, with the count discrepancy 0 at all 1201 t_m points on both declared multi-record surfaces against a full eigendecomposition, a no-eigenmode decay-fit instrument and a 60-digit mpmath root. The positive control beside that zero is a DIFFERENT configuration and is not the staircase itself: the asymptotic candidate width B - kT ln(f0 t_m) misses by exactly 1 at 82 of those same points, and the lane's own declared D-15 control is the symmetric surface, where the staircase is flat at k = 8 with a single threshold exact to 1e-12. On the multi-pathway T-31 carrier, different again, the one-f0 closed form leaves 0.62 ln-unit residuals that exceed the local step gap, and it is that carrier at eps = 0.16, not the declared grids, whose staircase steps 2 -> 1 -> 0 (C-86). In this historical corner block, alpha names a generic coupling strength — the magnitude of the local terms that do not respect the record's structure. The physical fine-structure alpha result is carried separately by A-AL2 as an exact construction-scoped ALLOW interval and a conditional governing-domain alpha requirement. Over all 28 settings of the sealed sweep, spanning temperature beta, coupling lambda, bath size, time and five energy seeds, 28 are INVARIANT and 0 MOVED, while on the six-setting lambda arm alone chi[record] ran from 0.004158 at lambda = 0.05 to 0.979185 at lambda = 3.0 and chi[stabs] and chi[wt-1] stayed at machine zero, worst 4.4e-15 — the sensitivity control standing beside that zero in the sealed table (C-21, H-2). This corner coupling's value sets the rate of formation, chi ~ lambda^(2n*), within the declared corner model. The T-54 fold-in now carries the k(t_m) portion through ProjectModel.census/count_widths and checks_countlaw.py. The n*, splitting-slope and formation-threshold portions remain in sealed lane machinery, so this assembled role block still names no single model function or gate; P-LAW-8 through P-LAW-10 carry the count-law functions and exact gates.

claims.scope: The corner results are FORMAL statements about DEF-A carriers (H-3). C-8's own qualifier is carried in the sentence: n* = d only for an unrestricted perturbation class. F-11 is cited for its mark only and not as warrant, on the D-10 ground P-FORM-3 states. O-10 is cited with its own flag kept: the ITEM reads UNTESTED and only the EVIDENCE supersedes it, so the favourable half is never reported alone. The drop-time law's shared-f0 assumption is declared in T-47 A's own D-24 audit and is not derived, and on the only multi-shell carrier in the corpus the closed form's residual exceeds the local step gap, so the step order there is carried by the record-mode instrument and not by the formula (P-LAW-8). claims.headline: the corner role rows are single-carrier and appear as context only
claims.prose: The three corner role rows are marked SINGLE-CARRIER by the sealed T-9 audit, each on toric-2x2: A-EM, A-GR and A-AL. The audit's refuter recorded why A-AL's claimed second carrier does not count — on toric-2x2 and Steane [[7,1,3]] n* = d, so the fitted exponents cannot discriminate the row's claim from eps^d, and the n* != d separation exists only on [[5,1,3]]. A-EM's evidence is the torus family and LANE_EM_EXTENT, and A-GR's theorems are all toric-family with the record-count lanes on the 2x2 and 2x3 torus alone. They therefore appear in the roles statement only as context and cannot supply cross-carrier breadth to a clause. The sealed T-15 table's then-current load-bearing citations were marked TWO-CARRIER; later A-AL2 and GFT-1 additions are NOT-CARRIER-SHAPED and retain their own theorem premises and scope ceilings. The audit's method — default SINGLE-CARRIER, an adversarial refuter required for every TWO-CARRIER claim — is stated once, in P-ROLES-9, and is not restated here. The ledger row that carries this requirement is PF-8 (OPEN) — every row re-run on at least two structurally different carriers — and T-9 is the plan task that ran the audit against it.

claims.headline: three of the four conditions on the emergence claim are not earned
claims.prose: The emergence claim's shape is the principal's and is registered: Gamma is the common structure that allows records to exist and appears at scale as geometry — shared origin (A-GR3) — stated over the boundary-shaping terms (A-GR4), under the binding caveat in the principal's own words that measures at the record level might behave differently from what has been seen in other contexts, so no behavioural assumption is imported as given and errors land on our measurements. The claim carries four conditions and three of them are not earned. OCCUPANCY OF CRITICALITY is PARTIALLY EARNED and scoped: C-91 eliminates the tuning freedom — occupancy is measure conservation of the surface's own writing, one computable bit, with the off-criticality alternative priced in closed form by the model's own erase channel — and the bit itself is not discharged, nothing in Gamma yet places the surface at criticality, and the surface's own critical point is not derived, since the constructions that would carry it are honest non-conserving ones; the scoping is the T-48 judge's own call, no pre-registered rule governs it, and its ratification sits with the principal (C-77, CANDIDATE). DESIGN-POINT ENFORCEMENT is NOT earned: which honest ensemble Gamma's actual writing enforces is undecided among three computed branches, and deciding it decides the occupancy bit too (O-58 N3). NORM SELECTION is open: the computed critical class is exact in an emergent Euclidean norm over earned L1 separation, and what norm the record's physics selects is unsettled (O-58 N4). Beside those three the anisotropy frontier is uncomputed — whether the D=3 class survives a biased-but-conserving ensemble weighting, and whether link indistinguishability can force the weight measure symmetric (O-58 N5). Three further rows of this family stand OPEN and are named here so they need not be read between the lines: the boundary-law coefficient is venue-dependent, 32 at the corner and 216 at the world tier, and no coefficient on the record surface has been shown universal (O-55); no temperature-like and no energy-like quantity has yet been earned on the record surface by D-24's standard, so the thermodynamic pair does not exist to be used (O-56); and the emergent content bound — whether a record-level dynamics makes stored content in excess of certifiable content unstable — is a staged target and not a result (O-57). The fourth condition, that a unique critical member exists, is O-58's N1 and is closed; it is reported with its scope in section 6. This program asserts nothing about classical gravity having been recovered or derived, and the comparison itself, with its verdict, its conditional structure and its named owners, is section 6's single block.

A-GR3 and A-GR4 are DEFINED: a decision about the claim's shape, which cannot be true or false. O-55, O-56 and O-57 are OPEN and are stated as debts, in the weakest form each row supports. This block states debts and states no result — it does not say the conditions are unmeetable, it says three of four are not met and names three further open rows beside them. Classical gravity is never the test at the record level (D-1); nothing in this block is a comparison, and the comparison belongs to section 6, this document's one comparison section. C-91 is now represented by ProjectModel.writing_* methods and the 57-gate writing family, including the conserving/critical lazy-kernel identity and the honest nonconserving alternatives. That integration does not discharge the antecedent: the physical surface still does not select the conserving ensemble or derive its critical point (P-GEO-11). The full limits statement is T-17's, not this document's.

claims.headline: alpha barrier dependence remains a separately registered debt
claims.prose: A-AL2 establishes the physical fine-structure alpha result as an exact construction-scoped ALLOW interval and a conditional governing-domain alpha requirement. The accumulate-versus-screen discriminator is computed and was adversarially confirmed by both refuters. The six erratum-era checks first put the worst treated occupancy page at 0.965292 against the best of 200 treated orientation draws at 0.091817 at N = 1000, widening from 11x to 112x by N = 1e5, with three configuration controls. T-50 has since superseded that validator topology with eight hardened S1–S6/B2/A2 gates; the live S4 discriminator named below carries the contrast with its own self-referenced controls. WHAT IS OWED IS T-50 (TODO, phase F): find a protocol whose reference a real V_t histogram supplies, or state plainly that the occupancy ratio has no runnable form and that what the surface owns is the sign law and the matched-N discriminator. Until T-50 lands, one row in this program meets the bar that any physicist anywhere can run against their own data, and it is C-71.
